purpose: Teach: 裏面/デタラメ/マズイ/酔っ払い/いまひとつ/合掌/かみさん/無茶苦茶

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のノートの裏面、落書きだらけだな
lines.en: Riku, your notebook's back cover is completely covered in doodles.
lines.style: Teasing jab delivered with a smirk. Light, surface-level criticism that's actually an invitation. Quick rhythm, no real heat behind it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストの答え半分デタラメだったろ、桜
lines.en: Says the person who wrote complete garbage for half the test answers, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflection disguised as a counter-attack. Calm delivery, slight lift at the end — he's not actually mad, just playing along. Eyes back on his work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の作ったオムレツ、マズイぞ
lines.en: Riku, that omelet you made was terrible.
lines.style: Delivered like she's stating a fact, not insulting. Matter-of-fact tone, slight drag at the end. She's testing how he'll react, genuinely curious.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭の打ち上げで酔っ払い気分だったな、桜
lines.en: You were absolutely plastered at the cultural festival after-party, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation stated without judgment. Slight warmth underneath — he's remembering something he shouldn't have to remind her of. Steady, almost gentle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のプレゼン、いまひとつだったぞ
lines.en: Riku, your presentation was kind of lacking.
lines.style: Honest criticism delivered quickly, like ripping off a bandage. Not mean — just direct. She's watching for his reaction, ready to laugh if he takes it well.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、卒業式で合掌するの渋すぎだぞ、桜
lines.en: You were way too cool for actually praying at graduation, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle tease with real affection underneath. Slow, slightly amused delivery. He's calling out her distance in a way that says he sees through it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家のお父さん、お母さんをかみさんって呼んでたな
lines.en: Your dad calls your mom 'the missus,' doesn't he, Riku?
lines.style: Curious observation delivered with genuine interest, not mockery. Lighter tone, almost delighted to have noticed this detail. Leaning in slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、無茶苦茶な計画立ててたな、桜
lines.en: You were coming up with absolutely wild plans back then, Sakura.
lines.style: Affectionate, almost wistful observation. Softer than before — nostalgia creeping in. Quiet smile in the voice, like remembering someone you miss a little.
